title: Jigsaw Backend — Overview
description: RED metrics, pgx pool saturation, Go runtime and product/revenue counters for jigsaw-backend.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Requests per second across all routes, including health checks.

panels.title: Error rate (5xx)
panels.description: Share of requests failing with a server error. Above 2% is a page-worthy incident.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile handler latency, excluding probe and metrics endpoints.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests being served right now. Sustained growth means saturation.

panels.title: DB pool used
panels.description: Checked-out connections as a share of the configured maximum. Near 100% means requests are queueing on the database.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Running build, from the jigsaw_build_info gauge. Use it to confirm a deploy landed.

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: Which endpoints carry the traffic.

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Status-code mix. A 4xx shift usually means a client bug or an abusive caller; 5xx means us.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: p50 vs p99 divergence points at a slow subset (large uploads, cold cache) rather than a global slowdown.

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95)
panels.description: Top 8 endpoints by p95 — where to start optimising.

panels.title: Errors by route
panels.description: Server errors attributed to an endpoint. Correlate with the logs by route + request_id.

panels.title: Rate limiting & panics
panels.description: Rejected requests by limiter, plus recovered panics (which should be flat at zero).

panels.title: Pool connections
panels.description: Acquired approaching max is the leading indicator of a latency cliff.

panels.title: Acquire pressure
panels.description: Any sustained 'waited' rate means requests are queueing for a connection: raise DB_MAX_CONNS or fix slow queries.

panels.title: Mean acquire wait
panels.description: Average time spent waiting for a pooled connection.

panels.title: Connection churn
panels.description: High churn wastes time on TCP+TLS handshakes; consider raising MinConns or the lifetime.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Monotonic growth means a goroutine leak.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Heap versus what the OS sees. A gap that keeps widening points at off-heap or fragmentation.

panels.title: CPU & GC
panels.description: CPU cores consumed and time spent in garbage collection.

panels.title: Auth events
panels.description: Failures rising while successes stay flat is the signature of credential stuffing.

panels.title: Purchase verifications
panels.description: Any sustained non-success means players are paying without being credited.

panels.title: Store verify latency (p95)
panels.description: Round-trip to Apple/Google. Slow verification stalls checkout even when it eventually succeeds.

panels.title: Gameplay events by mode
panels.description: Progression funnel: starts versus completes versus fails per game mode.

panels.title: Points flow & uploads
panels.description: Currency granted versus spent, and image-upload outcomes. A divergence in points suggests an exploit.
